# Reachable intent-router guidance over MCP

## Prospective repair

Baseline `4a3cdd4`. The root intent router links three existing design guides that
`loadKitDocs` does not register: `catalyst-settings-adapter`, `fathom-maintenance`
and `web-desktop-parity`. A server-only adopter cannot retrieve their required
composition/CSS, source-governance or independent-browser/native-boundary guidance.
The existing parity test lists documents manually, so it misses these router edges.

Register those three explicit document IDs through the existing exact-get/resource
path. Add short discovery pointers, not a new tool, recursive file service, schema,
renderer or runtime. Preserve document bytes, read-only annotations, missing-root
behavior, original sources and all certification/authority boundaries.
I8/I13/I15/I18 and the current adoption/agent-setup contracts apply. No ADR trigger
fires: this repairs promised router reachability rather than changing architecture.

## Fixed evidence

- Freeze a failing test-only baseline before production edits. All root-router
  `../design/*.md` links must resolve to a registered document, allowing existing
  explicit aliases; the actual MCP tool and resource return exact file bytes.
- Verify discovery, MIME/size/audience metadata and the three new guidance IDs.
  Keep Catalyst's complete composition/native CSS/app authority and unproven gates.
- Run scoped race tests/vet and an offline executable build. The existing opt-in
  stdio probe gains exact three-guide retrieval from a non-kit working directory,
  against the private candidate binary and source only. Licensed-data opt-in stays off.
- Retain source/tool/command/result identities and failures; verify edited source
  matches tested snapshots before landing. No browser rerun is needed for unchanged UI.
- Limit this packet to 30 minutes from 10:55 UTC. No consumer files, installed
  binaries, host registrations, daemon, dependencies or global configuration change.
  Rebuild/reconnect is an adopter action, not implied by this source repair.

Evidence root: `/Volumes/m2ext/appkit-evidence/appkit-router-guides.uq9DmqQt`.

## Results

The retained `red` snapshot fails precisely on the three missing registrations and
their discovery pointers. The router-derived check names each missing source file;
these failures remain failures, not certification evidence. The repaired snapshot
checks all 19 unique design-guide destinations linked from the root router through
the actual in-memory MCP tool/resource interface, including existing explicit aliases.
Exact source text, resource URI and Markdown MIME must agree.

The final frozen snapshot passes scoped race tests for `cmd/appkit-mcp` and
`internal/qualityplan` (502 test/subtest events; six skips), scoped vet and an offline
executable build. Skips are the archive's missing-Git binary guard and five ordinary
opt-in checks: purchased assets, private conversions, installed MCP, retained navbar
evidence and retained overlay evidence. The binary guard separately passes in the
actual Git checkout. The real stdio probe is separately enabled against the private
candidate from a non-kit working directory and passes with no skips, including all
three guides, catalog/quality identities, revision refusal and subsequent recovery.
The remaining commercial/private-evidence opt-ins were not executed by this packet.

The evidence root retains baseline archive, exact overlays, runner/tool identities,

The build disables VCS stamping and is identified by its retained source and binary
